title: POV: Walking Xi'an, Capital of 13 Dynasties | China Travel Expert
description:
POV: you're walking the historic streets of Xi'an — the city that was China's imperial capital longer than almost anywhere else.

As Chang'an, Xi'an served as the capital of 13 dynasties across more than 1,100 years, from the Zhou era down to the end of the Tang in 907. The Silk Road started here, the Terracotta Army was buried on its edge, and the old Ming city wall still rings the center. You're walking streets older than most countries on earth.

🧭 Expert Tip: Base yourself near the Bell Tower (钟楼) — it's the dead center of the walled old city, so the wall, the Muslim Quarter and the metro are all a short walk away.

POV：走在西安的老街上——古称长安，先后做过 13 个朝代、1100 多年的都城。
